p33_phase_trace.scope: H100-only globaltimer warp0 instruction-path diagnostics; other warp leaders retained as raw observations but excluded from phase interpretation, not pure component costs. No extra CTA/grid barriers. Target-specific timer behavior is not portable. Instrumented full-call timings only calibrate perturbation, not candidate ranking.
p33_phase_trace.limitations: Only warp0 interval statistics are interpreted: non-warp0 post-grid timer stamps are observed before the corresponding warp0 return and would misattribute grid waiting to packing. The cause is not isolated; BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING exists in SASS, possible independent instruction motion is a hypothesis, not a proved cause. Warp0 stamps pass max active pre-grid <= min post-grid consistency on every case. Warp leaders stamp instruction-path boundaries; other lanes may still have work. Active grid waits include skew/visibility, inactive waits include reduction time. Intervals include instrumentation and do not add to a kernel latency. Baseline source recompiled in same trace binary, not frozen compare_p33 binary. No Graph/two-stream/sanitizer acceptance or production performance claim.
